Because the declaration is checked against funding history rather than taken on trust, the trellis registry records each claim and the hollow audit publishes every slash. Attesters sign a declaration that they hold no common funding with the identity they attest, and a later finding of common funding voids the attestation and slashes 61% of the attester's bond. That is 13 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
